questions.question: Which hormone acts through second messengers like cyclic AMP (cAMP) and IP3 rather than entering the target cell nucleus?
questions.explanation: Water-soluble peptide and protein hormones like Follicle-Stimulating Hormone (FSH) bind to cell surface membrane receptors and generate secondary messengers such as cAMP.
